uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2185-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2185-3899-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3899-4550-5567-6254--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3899-4550-5567-6254--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1506-3459-7839.description:
Activate Battered Golem using the ability granted to it by Burning Anger by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
When the Treasure enters, Battered Golem triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Battered Golem trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Battered Golem by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target
Repeat steps 4 and 5 once, then repeat step 4 an additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

224-1525-4913-7889.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
224-1525-4913-7889.description:
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand, then put the land onto the battlefield tapped, and repeat this process once if you control at least eight lands.
Retreat to Coralhelm and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger for each land that enters the battlefield this way.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger(s), untapping Zimone and Dina.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger(s), creating that many creature tokens.
Repeat.

2113-4222-7208.description:
Activate Pestered Wellguard by tapping it, adding {U}.
Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Pestered Wellguard.
Repeat.

2248-3861-7857.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

2921-7084-7705.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4559-4659-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
4559-4659-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4659-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

6072-6556-7182.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with power 4 or greater.
6072-6556-7182.description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-4017-5086-5183-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4017-5086-5183-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-3703-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-3703-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

141-780-2034.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3054-3416-4268-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
3054-3416-4268-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Kor Celebrant triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

4195-4574-4708-5849.description:
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Dark Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Dark Sphere from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

671-4186-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-4186-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3698-4112-6767.description:
Cast Rescue Skiff by paying {5}{W}.
When Rescue Skiff enter the battlefield, it and Grinding Station trigger, with Rescue Skiff targeting Sharuum.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Rescue Skiff trigger, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it and Grinding Station trigger, with Sharuum targeting Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Rescue Skiff from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3858-6729.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Targ Nar by paying {2}{R}{G}, doubling its power and toughness until end of turn.
Repeat step 2 until Targ Nar has power 19 or greater.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.
3858-6729.notes: The mana cost of the combo can be reduced significantly depending on what Targ Nar's starting power is. The cost listed above assumes Targ Nar has a power of 2. The costs for other powers above this are: {6}{R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G} for power 3 or 4; {4}{R}{R}{G}{G} for power 5 through 9; {2}{R}{G} for power 10 through 18; {0} for power 19+.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3693-4565.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3693-4565.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

1174-2404-6678.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
1174-2404-6678.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's third ability by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out up to one target creature.
Repeat any number of times.
1174-2404-6678.notes: You need to control at least six creatures to produce the infinite mana results.

1808-2292-6291.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2577-4871-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {R}.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1766-1978-4324.description:
Animate Thran Dynamo using Workshop Elders.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

3334-4659-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
3334-4659-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

1124-1677-2034-4356.description:
Activate Chandra's second loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Elementals, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing an extra activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Ral Zarek's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Repeat.

654-774-3147.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2584-3496-4625.description:
Cast Dread Slaver by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Dread Slaver enters the battlefield, triggering Pandemonium, causing Dread Slaver to deal three damage to itself and die due to its deathtouch ability.
Dread Slaver dies, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-4658-5306.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
314-4658-5306.description:
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Vito triggers, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

1872-2882-3498.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Composite Golem.
1872-2882-3498.description:
Cast Hook-Haunt Drifter from your graveyard by paying it's disturb cost of {1}{U}.
Hook-Haunt Drifter enters the battlefield as a copy of Composite Golem.
Activate Hook-Haunt Drifter by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.

225-539-573-1257.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

147-2292-2596.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-2596.description:
Cast Living Death by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Living Death.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Living Death
Resolve the Living Death copy, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, and returning all cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat from step 3.

2103-2856-3554.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Mystical Tutor and Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Cast Mystical Tutor by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Seasons Past from your library.
Repeat.

224-1046-1257.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {G}.
224-1046-1257.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Living Twister's second ability by paying {G}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

2556-4305-4872.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Mnemonic Wall.
2556-4305-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3705-4191-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Squee, causing target player to mill cards equal to Squee's power.
Cast Squee from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
